gen-fs-teko-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded spreads its serif letters wide, each one floating apart with open counters. Stint Ultra Expanded would give a long page a slow, stately walk, while Teko's tight, bent-steel strokes up top keep things bold.
gen-eater-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads modern and friendly, with big-eyed lowercase and tubular strokes that feel like bent copper pipe, while Eater above it is dark and widely spaced. Body text will look best at a generous size.
gen-flavors-gf-vend-sans: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors stands tall with a towering x-height and diagonals as hefty as its stems. Vend Sans is the quiet counterweight, a ruler-straight, constant-width line whose x-height fills the line.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-soyomb: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary feel, with letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height. And Noto Sans Soyombo carries a longer read easily, its sizable x-height and wide, unclosed curves keeping a screen page comfortable.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, each stroke uniform from downstroke to curve, giving a futuristic, tech look. It does loud and bold; Noto Sans Palmyrene does quiet, short-ascendered text.
gen-eater-gf-yaldevi: Dark, gappy and a bit menacing. Eater earns its attention with hairline-free thin strokes beside weighty stems, while Yaldevi simply does the reading, its e opening clearly to the right with outsized lowercase.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Letters that never seem to pinch shut give Almendra Display its ornate, literary openness. Noto Sans Syriac matches that generosity with blown-glass lowercase bowls and s shapes that turn wide and easy, approachable and modern.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa reads contemporary and approachable, with c openings you can see through and a gentle step up to capitals. And Flavors, whimsical up top, has crossbars as thick as its stems, so a longer page feels light.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tagban: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display leads with a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Tagbanwa follows in clean, open curves with lowercase filling most of the height, so the two share a tall, generous stance.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Audiowide gives every letter part the same visual mass, like tiles set with wide grout lines, which makes it futuristic. Noto Sans Saurashtra stays neutral beside it, with barely taller capitals and counters open to the outside.
